# Structured planning baseline

These files are the versioned source for generated documentation. GitHub issues and the Project hold live execution state; this baseline is not a controller that resets assignees or status.

[The publication record](../docs/PUBLICATION.json) records the created GitHub objects. Its optional `issue_urls` map links stable LB IDs to verified issue URLs; the renderer links only entries that have been recorded and leaves unpublished packages as plain text.

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [project-backlog.json](project-backlog.json) | Canonical program, epics, work packages, checklists, prerequisites and acceptance |
| [concept.json](concept.json) | Product, architecture, organization boundaries and reviewed design summary |
| [metrics-and-ingestion.json](metrics-and-ingestion.json) | Full metric definitions, counting rules, sources, ingestion and privacy policy |
| [metric-backlog-coverage.json](metric-backlog-coverage.json) | Every metric mapped to deliverable packages and release classes |
| [ui/ui-concept.json](ui/ui-concept.json) | Complete reviewed UI concept and sanitized actual-model attribution |
| [ui/ui-backlog-coverage.json](ui/ui-backlog-coverage.json) | UI source tasks mapped to the canonical LB hierarchy |
| [decision-register.json](decision-register.json) | Proposed decisions, accountable roles and prerequisites |
| [release-manifest.json](release-manifest.json) | Mandatory foundations, product journey, conditional modules and live readback |
| [source-audit.json](source-audit.json) | Historical public organization inventory and explicit limits |
| [organization-inventory-2026-10-18.json](organization-inventory-2026-10-18.json) | Dated complete public repository/issue/PR inventory, six Project identities, all configured field IDs and existing owner roles |
| [metric-api-evidence.json](metric-api-evidence.json) | Time-bounded official API references and source capability findings |
| [plan-review-resolution.json](plan-review-resolution.json) | Review findings and their planned resolutions |

Update related mappings when changing a package or metric. Recompute the UI map's master SHA with `python scripts/sync_baseline.py` after an intentional backlog edit, then run `python scripts/render_docs.py`. Validation detects missing references, mismatched definitions and generated-document drift. It does not fetch sources or authorize deployment.
